# NCAA RAPM fixtures

## `ncaa_{mbb,wbb}_name_changes.parquet`

Game-time -> current player-name crosswalk.

**Why it exists.** stats.ncaa.org re-renders roster and box pages with a
player's CURRENT name, while the play-by-play preserves the name as it was at
game time. A player who changes their name therefore never matches between
`possessions` and `team_rosters`, and no safe string rule bridges
`KATELYNN.LIMARDO -> KATELYNN.MARTIN` or `MICHELLE.DUCHEMIN -> SHELLEY.DUCHEMIN`.

**Source.** The `box_score` page binds both renderings to one numeric player id:

```
shot JS   addShot(..., '... player_768547579 team_201', ...)
          "1st 06:33 : made by Miah Monahan(Eastern Ill.) 9-7"   <- game-time
dropdown  <option value="768547579">Miah Meyer</option>          <- current
```

| file | source | captured | games scanned | rows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ncaa_wbb_name_changes.parquet` | `ncaa-wbb-hoops-raw` `wbb/raw/**` `box_score` | 2026-08-18 | 93,884 | 658 |
| `ncaa_mbb_name_changes.parquet` | `ncaa-mbb-hoops-raw` `mbb/raw/**` `box_score` | 2026-08-18 | 99,932 | 1,085 |

Columns: `season`, `team`, `name_game_time`, `name_current` (all `Utf8`,
name-code form), `n_games` (`Int64`).

## KNOWN GAP: 2019+ only

The binding is the shot-chart JS, and shot charts only exist from **2019**
onward -- the same boundary that makes the published `shots` dataset 2019+.
Pre-2019 `box_score` pages carry no `addShot` calls, so there is no game-time
name to bind. Per-season row counts confirm it: WBB 2019-2026 only, MBB
2019-2026 only.

Measured effect on fully-resolved possessions (`non_di="pool"`):

| | prefix tiers only | + crosswalk |
|---|---|---|
| WBB 2024 | 91.65% | **96.43%** (+40,260) |
| MBB 2024 | 91.88% | **95.65%** (+32,931) |
| WBB 2016 | 85.23% | 85.23% (+0) |
| WBB 2011 | 86.53% | 86.53% (+0) |

**There is no stable person id to fall back on.** Verified across all 17
seasons: 83,518 roster rows carry 83,518 distinct `player_id`s, none appearing
in more than one season; of 23,302 `(team, player)` pairs spanning multiple
seasons, 23,286 receive a new id every season and 0 are stable. The
`/players/{id}` links on `individual_stats` are those same per-season ids
(Miah Meyer: 7524854 / 7691941 / 8159573 for 2022 / 2023 / 2024). Cross-season
player identity must therefore be SYNTHESIZED, not looked up.

## Regenerate

```sh
uv run python dev/ncaa_rapm/build_name_changes.py --league wbb
uv run python dev/ncaa_rapm/build_name_changes.py --league mbb
```

~3 minutes per league over the full raw tree. Only rows whose two CODED names
differ are emitted -- comparing raw HTML strings yields false positives from
entity/whitespace noise (an early run "found" `KIERA.EDMONDS -> KIERA.EDMONDS`).

**Follow-up:** the builder lives in gitignored `dev/`. It reads the `-raw`
trees, so under the raw/data boundary its durable home is a builder in the
`ncaa-{mbb,wbb}-hoops-data` repos emitting a published `ncaa_{lg}_name_changes`
dataset, rather than a fixture regenerated by hand.
